description: Which path a question about data should take (reuse, rerun, answer, tool_run, estimate, bespoke, ask or none), with the reason, every path's score and time, and the ready input for the path it picks. Executes nothing and charges nothing.

MetaEntry.description:
One piece of metadata about a question (LAT-3752; operator 2026-10-04: "the metadata should be a list"). The list
is OPEN: any key is accepted. `source` says who said it: `stated` (the caller) or `derived` (the server looked it up).
A caller can only ever produce `stated` entries; entitlement keys are read only from `derived` (meta.RESERVED).
MetaEntry.title: MetaEntry
